content.short: Protico enables native, in-app chat and communities for users and enterprises across apps.
content.description: Protico's Web3 Lobby enables enterprises to embed native communities directly into their products—web and mobile experiences—so users stay engaged without being redirected to third‑party social apps like Discord or Telegram. For users, it means joining communities inside the products they already use, delivering seamless Web3 chat experiences with wallet‑bundled IDs and assets. By keeping conversations and ownership in‑app, Protico reduces friction compared with external channels and helps protect the value of user assets.
